Subject: Initial PO staging for Streamline Procure (provisional list attached)

Hi Jenna —

Thanks again for getting the onboarding packet started. Attached is the provisional PO staging export from our onboarding workflow. This is not the final PO issuance, but it will let your team reconcile invoices against provisional identifiers while finance completes accounting validation.

What we need from you by EOD Thursday:
- Confirm SKU-to-line-item mapping for the 7 invoice line items listed in column C of provisional_po_list.csv.
- Re-upload the vendor onboarding form with a contact phone on page 2 (we attached the PDF we received; please return as vendor_onboarding_form.pdf).
- Call out any single line items that need to be split into multiple charge lines (e.g., multi-usage SKUs).

Notes on our process: provisional PO numbers start with P-YYYYMMDD-XXXXX and will be replaced with a final PO after finance clears spend caps and tax jurisdiction. Temporary spend caps are applied per account; any request to increase a cap requires approval from Finance (Laura) and Procurement (Kimberly).

Attachments: provisional_po_list.csv, vendor_onboarding_form.pdf

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

—
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
From: Jenna Parker <jenna@streamline-procure.com>

Date: 2026-10-03T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial PO staging for Streamline Procure (provisional list attached)

Thanks, Sofia —

Received the provisional list and the onboarding pdf. Quick questions after a first pass:
1) Line item 4 shows a bundled SKU (4582) that on our side splits into "compute" and "storage" charges — can we get guidance on how you'd like that reflected? If Redwood needs two separate ledger lines we can resubmit a split mapping.
2) The provisional PO numbers are fine for reconciliation, but our AP team needs a timeline for when final PO numbers will land (we typically hold invoices until final PO is issued). What is the expected SLA here?
3) Our procurement policy requires any single invoice over $25k to have a spend cap sign-off. Line item 6 is at $29,300 in the provisional list — is that going to trigger a cap increase or do you prefer we split the invoice?

I'll circulate internally and get the updated mapping by tomorrow afternoon. Attaching a short note from AP with the specific field requirements (attachment: ap_field_requirements.txt).

Date: 2026-10-04T08:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial PO staging for Streamline Procure (provisional list attached)

Hi Jenna — thanks for the quick review and the AP note. Answers inline below.

1) SKU 4582: please resubmit as two separate line items (4582-A compute, 4582-B storage) using the lineitem_map_template.xlsx we attached. Our ledger requires single-charge mapping per ledger code to avoid split-accounting exceptions.
2) Final PO issuance SLA: typical turnaround is 3 business days from when we receive a validated mapping and the completed onboarding form. Exceptions (large spend cap changes, tax review) can add 2–5 business days. We will move your provisional P-20261003-XXXXX entries to final POs within that SLA once Finance confirms.
3) Line item 6 at $29,300: that does trigger a spend cap review. If you can split the charge into two lines under $25k we can avoid the cap escalation; otherwise, Kimberly will need to initiate a temporary cap exception.

Action items for Streamline Procure:
- Send updated lineitem_map_template.xlsx with SKU splits for 4582 and any others you plan to split.
- Re-upload the vendor_onboarding_form.pdf with phone.

Kimberly/Laura — looping you in because of the cap and approval workflow above. Marcus, FYI on ledger mapping if there are any constraints.

Thanks,
Sofia
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Jenna Parker <jenna@streamline-procure.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T10:36:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial PO staging for Streamline Procure (provisional list attached)

Hi all —

I've looked at the provisional export and the flagged $29,300 line. I'm okay to approve a temporary spend cap increase to $35k for Streamline while we finalize the contract addendum, provided we receive:
- A short approval note from Streamline (one-paragraph) accepting the temporary cap and confirming the invoice split plan for future months.
- Finalized lineitem_map_template.xlsx with the 4582 split.

I've attached an internal approval note (approval_note.pdf) for records and a DocuSign link for the temporary amendment: https://redwood.app/ds/doc/abc123-docu-sign

Process: once the mapping and the signed amendment are returned, Finance (Laura) will replace the provisional PO numbers with final POs and post the cap change. Expected timeline: 1–2 business days after signed amendment + validated mapping.

If Streamline prefers to split the $29,300 into two lines (<$25k each), that's also acceptable and will keep this out of an amendment.

—
Kimberly Park
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference

- Sign the temporary amendment via the DocuSign link if we can't split the $29,300 cleanly — but aiming to split to avoid the amendment.

Can you confirm that once we upload the mapping and signed amendment (if needed), final PO numbers will be issued within 48 business hours? We need to advise AP on invoice submission timing.
